name: Misconfigured workflow

blockers.description: The release workflow is not triggered for the release branch or release tag.

acceptable_extra_findings.note: A narrowly stated workflow-permissions observation is an acceptable secondary finding.

forbidden_findings.note: A passing-test claim is unsupported by this workflow-trigger fixture and is a known trap.

notes: Held-out case. The release trigger must be evaluated from the workflow configuration, not inferred from unrelated CI success.
